title: Timothy's Report, Paul's Joy and Prayer

questions.question: When they could bear it no longer, they were willing to be left behind at ____ alone, and sent Timothy.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:1 (ESV): "Therefore when we could bear it no longer, we were willing to be left behind at Athens alone,"

questions.question: Timothy was sent to establish and exhort them in their ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:2 (ESV): "and we sent Timothy, our brother and God's coworker in the gospel of Christ, to establish and exhort you in your faith,"

questions.question: That no one be moved by these ____. For you yourselves know that we are destined for this.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:3 (ESV): "that no one be moved by these afflictions. For you yourselves know that we are destined for this."

questions.question: Paul feared that somehow the ____ had tempted them and that their labor would be in vain.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:5 (ESV): "For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to learn about your faith, for fear that somehow the tempter had tempted you and that our labor would be in vain."

questions.question: Timothy brought them the good news of their faith and ____, and reported that they always remember Paul kindly.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:6 (ESV): "But now that Timothy has come to us from you, and has brought us the good news of your faith and love and reported that you always remember us kindly..."

questions.question: Through all Paul's distress and affliction they have been comforted about the Thessalonians through their ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:7 (ESV): "for this reason, brothers, in all our distress and affliction we have been comforted about you through your faith."

questions.question: Paul exclaims: "For now we live, if you are ____ fast in the Lord."
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:8 (ESV): "For now we live, if you are standing fast in the Lord."

questions.question: For what thanksgiving can we return to God for you, for all the ____ that we feel for your sake before our God.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:9 (ESV): "For what thanksgiving can we return to God for you, for all the joy that we feel for your sake before our God,"

questions.question: They pray most earnestly ____ and ____ that they may see them face to face and supply what is lacking in their faith.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:10 (ESV): "as we pray most earnestly night and day that we may see you face to face and supply what is lacking in your faith?"

questions.question: Paul prays that God the Father and our Lord Jesus may ____ their way to them.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:11 (ESV): "Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you,"

questions.question: He prays that the Lord may make them increase and abound in ____ for one another and for all.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:12 (ESV): "and may the Lord make you increase and abound in love for one another and for all, as we do for you,"

questions.question: He prays that he may establish their hearts blameless in ____ before our God and Father,
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:13 (ESV): "so that he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father,"

questions.question: When will God establish their hearts blameless in holiness? At the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:13 (ESV): "so that he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints."

questions.question: Paul asks how they can return to God enough ____ for the joy they feel.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:9 (ESV): "For what thanksgiving can we return to God for you, for all the joy that we feel for your sake before our God,"

questions.question: Paul relates their current affliction to something they had told them ____ would happen.
questions.explanation: 1 Thessalonians 3:4 (ESV): "For when we were with you, we kept telling you beforehand that we were to suffer affliction, just as it has come to pass, and just as you know."

key_verse_text: and may the Lord make you increase and abound in love for one another and for all, as we do for you, so that he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
